patchGroups.groupName: Starclassic Bubinga Elite 13x6 shell and hardware update

shell.bearingEdge: Starclassic rounded bearing edge profile; edge positioned 2.5mm inward from outer shell surface

notes.scoringBasis: Tama official Starclassic Bubinga reissue news supports the original Starclassic Bubinga shell family as 9-ply, 6mm shell construction with 7mm for snare and bass drums as it was when discontinued in 2018. Secondary listing confirms the 13x6 Starclassic Bubinga snare format with bubinga shell and outer cordia/decorative veneer. Applied to the exact Starclassic Bubinga Elite 13x6 record only. Used the established Starclassic Bubinga family hardware/bearing-edge/snappy-bed values already applied to the 14 inch Starclassic Bubinga records. Stock batter/reso heads remain unconfirmed.
